subject: Money
title: Forward Guidance
description: A micro-lesson that makes Forward Guidance usable.

hook.text: In 2012, the Fed said rates would stay at zero until unemployment fell below 6.5%. Markets moved instantly.

buildup.text: Forward guidance is telling markets what you plan to do. The announcement itself changes behavior.

discovery.text: If the Fed says rates will stay low, businesses invest now. If it hints at hikes, spending slows before any change.

twist.text: Words are a tool. A central banker's speech can move trillions without buying or selling a single bond.

climax.text: The risk: if the Fed says one thing and does another, credibility collapses. Trust is all a central bank has.

punchline.text: In central banking, talking is doing.

quiz.question: How does forward guidance affect the economy?
options: Markets adjust behavior based on the central bank's stated plans
